content:
# Adding a Logs S3 Bucket + IRSA Role + Flux Kustomization

## 1. Base manifests — `infra/s3/logs/`

### `infra/s3/logs/bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    tags:
      Environment: overridden-by-overlay
      ManagedBy: flux
      Service: myapp-logs
```

### `infra/s3/logs/bucket-versioning.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        s3.bucket/name: myapp-logs
    versioningConfiguration:
      - status: Enabled
```

### `infra/s3/logs/bucket-server-side-encryption.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        s3.bucket/name: myapp-logs
    rule:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          - sseAlgorithm: AES256
```

### `infra/s3/logs/bucket-public-access-block.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        s3.bucket/name: myapp-logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

> Label selectors need the Bucket to carry them — add labels to the Bucket:

```yaml
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  labels:
    s3.bucket/name: myapp-logs
```

### `infra/s3/logs/bucket-policy.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketPolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        s3.bucket/name: myapp-logs
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Sid": "DenyInsecureTransport",
            "Effect": "Deny",
            "Principal": "*",
            "Action": "s3:*",
            "Resource": [
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs",
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs/*"
            ],
            "Condition": {
              "Bool": { "aws:SecureTransport": "false" }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
```

### `infra/s3/logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - bucket-versioning.yaml
  - bucket-server-side-encryption.yaml
  - bucket-public-access-block.yaml
  - bucket-policy.yaml
```

## 2. IRSA role — `infra/iam/logs-role/`

### `infra/iam/logs-role/role.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "${oidcProviderArn}"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "${oidcProviderHost}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:logs-writer",
                "${oidcProviderHost}:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    tags:
      ManagedBy: flux
      Service: myapp-logs
```

`${oidcProviderArn}` / `${oidcProviderHost}` are replaced per-overlay via `replacements` (values differ per cluster).

### `infra/iam/logs-role/policy.yaml`

Least-privilege read/write on the logs bucket only — no wildcards on actions, resource-scoped:

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Sid": "ListBucket",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs"
          },
          {
            "Sid": "ReadWriteObjects",
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject",
              "s3:AbortMultipartUpload", "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"
            ],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs/*"
          }
        ]
      }
```

### `infra/iam/logs-role/role-policy-attachment.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    policyArnSelector:
      matchLabels:
        iam.policy/name: myapp-logs-rw
    roleSelector:
      matchLabels:
        iam.role/name: myapp-logs-irsa
```

(Add matching labels to the Role and Policy metadata.)

### `infra/iam/logs-role/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - role.yaml
  - policy.yaml
  - role-policy-attachment.yaml
```

## 3. Overlays

### `overlays/dev/logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../infra/s3/logs
  - ../../../infra/iam/logs-role
patches:
  - target:
      group: s3.aws.upbound.io
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/region
        value: us-east-1
replacements:
  - source:
      kind: ConfigMap
      name: cluster-oidc
      fieldPath: data.providerArn
    targets:
      - select:
          group: iam.aws.upbound.io
          kind: Role
          name: myapp-logs-irsa
        fieldPaths:
          - spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
        options:
          delimiter: "\""
transforms:
  - |-
    # append env suffix to bucket name + all label/ARN references
```

Simpler and more common in knr-ops: use name-suffix transforms plus a shared ConfigMap:

```yaml
configMapGenerator:
  - name: cluster-oidc
    literals:
      - providerArn=arn:aws:iam::111111111111:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVCLUSTERID
      - providerHost=oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVCLUSTERID
nameSuffix: -dev
namespace: ack-system
```

With `nameSuffix: -dev`, the reconciled bucket becomes `myapp-logs-dev` (ack controllers use `metadata.name` as bucket name by default), and the IAM policy ARN references are patched accordingly:

```yaml
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Policy
      name: myapp-logs-rw
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/policy
        value: |
          {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [
              {"Sid":"ListBucket","Effect":"Allow",
               "Action":["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketLocation"],
               "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev"},
              {"Sid":"ReadWriteObjects","Effect":"Allow",
               "Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject","s3:DeleteObject",
                         "s3:AbortMultipartUpload","s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"],
               "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"}
            ]
          }
```

### `overlays/prod/logs/kustomization.yaml`

Identical structure with:

```yaml
nameSuffix: -prod
# providerArn/providerHost point to the prod cluster's OIDC provider
# region: us-east-1 (or prod region)
# optional: cross-account OIDC ARNs if prod is in a separate account
```

## 4. SOPS for sensitive values

OIDC provider details aren't secrets, but if you need to keep the prod AWS account ID or external-ID out of plaintext:

`infra/iam/logs-role/secrets/oidc.sops.yaml` (encrypted):

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-oidc
type: Opaque
stringData:
  providerArn: ENC[AES256_GCM,data:...,tag:...]
```

Flux (with SOPS decryption configured in the cluster) decrypts this before kustomize builds; the overlay's `replacements` source then reads from the Secret instead of a ConfigMap.

## 5. Flux kustomization — `flux/kustomizations-logs.yaml`

```yaml
---
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata:
  name: knr-ops
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1m
  ref:
    branch: main
  url: https://github.com/org/knr-ops
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/dev/logs
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  wait: true
  timeout: 3m
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/prod/logs
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  wait: true
  timeout: 3m
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
```

## Verification

```bash
kubectl kustomize overlays/dev/logs   # renders myapp-logs-dev resources
kubectl kustomize overlays/prod/logs  # renders myapp-logs-prod resources
flux reconcile kustomization logs-dev -n flux-system
kubectl get bucket myapp-logs-dev -n ack-system
```

**Acceptance check:** ✅ versioned, ✅ AES256 SSE, ✅ public access fully blocked (+ deny-insecure-transport policy), ✅ IRSA trust restricted to a single service account, least-privilege read/write actions (no wildcards), ✅ dev/prod independently reconciled via separate Flux Kustomizations so changing prod cannot touch dev state.
